pages.title: Chain Arrow
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Bows, Crossbows$(br2)§lEffect: §r Arrows bounce to nearby enemies after hitting; higher levels increase the bounce count. Conflicts with Explosive Arrow.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
